subject: prd/implement-now
statement: If a direct issue reference mismatches configured authority, readiness cannot be proved, the admitted source/contract differs, or independent review cannot be verified, then the system shall stop the selected run with a typed refusal or pending-review result, retain existing immutable evidence and work, and perform zero unrelated proposal/artifact lookups, repairs, claims, or model launches; permit only exact selected-source/comment/blocker facts and bounded shared metadata/index reads needed for selection
intent: exact reason, issue/contract reference, and recovery action; never a verified-PR claim
fit_criterion: negative selection, dependency, source mutation, capsule conflict, review setup, exact-head, and pending-obligation fixtures cannot widen execution or count as verified
